source_justification: The retained candidate trace has 358 decode-time 4-byte D2H copies immediately before long stream synchronizations. Every copy is produced by the same CUB int reduction used by CUDA boolean advanced indexing. In pinned SGLang v0.5.13, BatchedPenalizerOrchestrator.is_required is already a Python bool; the data-dependent scalar is produced by BatchedMinNewTokensPenalizer._apply at logits[mask] += stop_token_penalties[mask]. Maintain exact per-request min-token progress by request id on host across cumulate, filter, and merge; zero a row only on its known host transition; and use a dense add only while any host row remains active. This preserves penalty tensors and stop-token semantics while removing the per-step nonzero count readback.
